tasks.title: Design PostgreSQL schema and migrations for users, profiles, courses, notes, tags, groups, memberships, join requests, ratings, comments, bookmarks, reports and moderation actions
Create design system and core UI components (indigo theme, buttons, inputs, cards, chips, bottom sheet, toast, responsive bottom nav and desktop sidebar)
Set up project scaffolding: React app, Node.js REST API, PostgreSQL connection, HTTPS config, AWS S3 bucket, CI and deploy pipeline

Build authentication backend: university email registration and domain validation, email verification link, bcrypt hashing, JWT login, role-based access (Student, Group Admin, Moderator, Platform Administrator)
Build Sign Up / Log In and Profile screens: auth forms, verification state, profile edit, course chips, bookmarks and uploads tabs
Implement note upload backend: S3 presigned upload, 20 MB PDF/image validation, malware scan before publishing, note metadata and tags APIs
Implement note search and filter API (keyword, university, course, topic, rating; relevance sort via PostgreSQL full-text search with indexes) and download endpoint
Build Home Browse, Upload Note and Note Detail screens (search, filter sheet, course chips, note cards, upload form with progress, file preview and download)
Implement study groups backend: create public/private groups, join, request/approve/reject, remove members, admin role assignment, group listing and search APIs
Build Study Groups screen: Discover, My Groups and Requests tabs, group cards, create group modal, join/request buttons, admin member management
Implement ratings, comments and bookmarks APIs and UI (star rating with live average, comment list, bookmark toggle, bookmarks page)
Implement reporting and moderation: report API and modal, moderator queue, remove content, suspend user, dismiss, author notification, hide removed content from all queries
Implement GDPR account deletion (30-day purge job), privacy and terms pages, and data cleanup of notes, comments and S3 files
Performance and QA pass: index tuning, load test at 500 concurrent users, WCAG AA and responsive checks, acceptance-criteria test run, production deploy with uptime monitoring

risks: Malware scanning of uploads may be slow or costly to integrate; mitigate with an S3-triggered scan (e.g., ClamAV Lambda) and a pending-publish state.
University email domain verification requires a maintained domain allowlist and reliable email delivery; use a transactional email service and a small seed list of universities.
Meeting 500 concurrent users with sub-1-second search may need PostgreSQL full-text indexing tuning and caching; schedule early load testing.
Copyright and abusive content could appear before moderation tools ship; limit launch to a small pilot group and prioritize report/remove flow.
Scope is large for a small team; if time slips, cut F4 and F5 polish (comments, suspension durations) and keep core note sharing, groups and auth.
